apps.name: Qik Font
apps.tagline: Add stylish text to your photos with beautiful fonts, colors and backgrounds.
apps.description:
Turn any photo into eye-catching typography with Qik Font. Pick a picture, add your words and style them in seconds – right on your phone.

Perfect for quotes, social media posts, stories, wallpapers, greetings and anything else you want to say with style.
features: Add as many texts as you like to any photo
Choose from a collection of beautiful fonts
Customize text color, background and alignment
Pinch to zoom and rotate text with two fingers, drag to place it anywhere
Adjust and fit your photo on a full-screen canvas
Find, edit or remove texts quickly from the text list
Save your projects as drafts and continue later
Export your design and share it straight to your favorite apps
Clean glass-style design with Light, Dark or System theme
Quick tips and a step-by-step guide to get you started

apps.name: Color Battle
apps.tagline: Read the word, not the ink! A fast, fun brain game to test your reflexes.
apps.description:
The word says BLUE… but it's painted red. Which tile do you tap?

Color Battle is a quick, colorful brain game that tests your focus and reflexes. Read the WORD, ignore the ink, and tap the matching color before the fuse burns out. It sounds easy. Your brain will disagree!
features: Tap the tile that matches what the word SAYS, not the color it is painted in
Only a few seconds per question and 3 hearts per game
Combo multiplier up to x5, best scores and up to 3 stars on each level
3 levels: Easy (2×2, 4 colors), Medium (3×3, 9 colors) and Hard (4×4, all 16 colors)
A new Daily Challenge with bonus XP every day, plus daily streak rewards
Level up with XP and unlock new colors
Collect all 16 color stickers, from Common to Epic, and unlock 9 awards
Color-blind mode, reduce-motion option and dark mode
Music, sound effects and haptics you can switch on or off
English & Vietnamese

apps.name: Lockit
apps.tagline: Protect your privacy. Lock apps with PIN and customize security easily.
apps.description:
Protect your privacy and keep your apps secure with Lockit.

Lockit lets you lock selected apps on your device so only you can access them. Whether it’s social media, messages, photos, or banking apps, you stay in control of your privacy. With a simple and clean interface, Lockit makes it easy to choose which apps you want to protect and secure them with a PIN code.
